title: HAC-Remaster
description: Minimal Minecraft mod to make blocks movable. Recreation of the old mod HariboteAirCraft.
body:
---
  # HAC Remaster

  A faithful remaster of **HariboteAirCraft (HAC) 1.7.2** — the classic flying machine mod — rebuilt from
  scratch for Minecraft 1.21.11 on Fabric.

  Mount a **Pyxis block** to capture your build and take to the skies. Any connected block structure becomes a
   pilotable flying craft.

  ---

  ## Features

  - **Craft Capture** — Mounting the Pyxis triggers a flood-fill scan of all connected blocks. They are
  snapshotted, removed from the world, and spawned as a flying entity cluster.
  - **Flight Controls** — Hold keys to accelerate forward/backward, strafe, turn, and ascend/descend. Matches
  the original HAC 1.7.2 movement feel with a level-based state machine.
  - **Passenger Support** — Mobs and players riding the craft at capture time are carried along as passengers
  during flight.
  - **Config File** — Tune block limits and ignored-block lists via `config/hac_remaster.json`.
  - **Smooth Landing** — Dismount the Pyxis to materialize the craft back into the world at its current
  position and orientation.

  ---

  ## Requirements

  | Side | Required |
  |------|----------|
  | Client | ✅ Yes |
  | Server | ✅ Yes |

  - **Minecraft**: 1.21.11
  - **Mod loader**: Fabric
  - **Fabric API**: 0.139.4+1.21.11 or later

  ---

  ## Origin

  This mod is a remaster of the original HariboteAirCraft(the creator has been missing).

  ---

  Free to use.![Using Pyxis block to lift a village house up.]
